description: Sign in to Tailscale on this node (`tailscale login`). Returns the browser URL a person completes it at; call connect afterwards.

authorization_url.description: Tailscale sign-in page when the node still needs a login; open it, then call connect again.

backend_state.description: Backend state reported by the client after the call.

connected.description: True when the node is connected to the tailnet after the call.
